svg.title: Pretrained Nimbus residual U-Net
svg.desc: The pinned V1 network takes one normalized marker plane and one binary cell-interior plane. Four max-pool steps pass through encoder widths64,128,256,512,1024. Four transposed-convolution decoder stages concatenate spatially cropped encoder features. A projection shortcut is cropped and added inside each residual block. Exact valid-convolution spatial sides are shown for a1024 input; the final1x1 convolution and sigmoid produce one836-square marker-score map. The weights remain fixed in the pipeline. Feature textures and the crop grid are schematic.
